The person asks:
By when does FunkNetz have to receive my cancellation?

response.text:
Your cancellation of the FunkNetz Smart M contract must **arrive by Wed 14 Oct 2026** [contract:ctr_fyt9k994t9q2].

- The current term ends Sat 14 Nov 2026, and cancellations count when they arrive (§ 130 BGB), not when sent [contract:ctr_fyt9k994t9q2].
- To be safe, Ordnung recommends posting it by Thu 8 Oct 2026 to allow time for delivery [contract:ctr_fyt9k994t9q2].
- After the minimum term, you can otherwise cancel any time with one month's notice at no cost (§ 56 Abs. 3, 4 TKG) [contract:ctr_fyt9k994t9q2].

You can draft the cancellation letter in Ordnung when ready.
